face.wands.upright.name: Ignite
face.wands.reversed.name: Smoke

face.pentacles.upright.name: Harvest

face.swords.upright.text: This turn, roll the Fate Die twice and keep the higher result. Gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.swords.reversed.name: Cut
face.swords.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}.
face.cups.upright.name: Overflow
face.cups.reversed.name: Heartache
face.cups.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you discards {discard|random card|random cards}.

face.page.upright.text: Move forward to the next Air sign and draw {draw|card|cards}.
face.page.reversed.name: Rumour
face.page.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}, discards {discard|random card|random cards} and is Silenced next turn.
face.knight.upright.name: Charge
face.knight.upright.text: Move forward to the next Fire sign, then {extra|more space|more spaces}.
face.knight.reversed.name: Joust
face.knight.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back to the previous Earth sign and is Stunned next turn.
face.queen.upright.name: Grace
face.queen.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}, gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} and become Shielded.
face.queen.reversed.name: Scorn
face.queen.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back to the previous Fire sign and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
face.king.upright.name: Dominion
face.king.reversed.name: Tyranny
face.king.reversed.text: Every player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces} and is Silenced next turn. All other players are Drained next turn.
face.fool.upright.name: Leap of Faith
face.fool.upright.text: Roll the Fate Die and move forward that many spaces + {bonus}.
face.fool.reversed.name: Wrong Turn
face.fool.reversed.text: Choose a player ahead of you. On their next Move step, they move back {back|space|spaces} instead of rolling{leader}.
face.magician.upright.name: Conjure
face.magician.upright.text: Draw {draw|card|cards}. You may immediately play up to {extraPlays|Minor card|Minor cards} without using your action.

face.empress.reversed.name: Overgrowth
face.empress.reversed.text: A player ahead of you is Rooted next turn, loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points} and moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader}.
face.emperor.upright.name: Command
face.emperor.upright.text: Gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} and become Shielded. Your Move roll this turn counts as {roll}.

face.hierophant.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back to the previous Earth sign{leader}.

face.chariot.upright.name: Full Speed

face.justice.reversed.name: Verdict

face.hangedMan.upright.text: Move forward {move|space|spaces}, gain {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points}, draw {draw|card|cards} and become Shielded. You are Slowed next turn.
face.hangedMan.reversed.name: Suspend

face.death.reversed.name: Reap
face.death.reversed.text: A player ahead of you moves back {back|space|spaces}{leader} and loses {fpLoss|Fate Point|Fate Points}.

face.devil.reversed.name: Chains

face.sun.upright.name: Radiance

face.sun.reversed.name: Scorch

face.judgement.reversed.name: Reckoning

status.slowed.desc: Your Move step goes exactly 1 space: no roll, reroll or boost.
status.silenced.desc: You cannot play cards (no Minor card, no court combo).
status.drained.desc: You cannot spend Fate Points; you still gain them.
status.stunned.desc: You skip Play and Flip: you only draw and move.
status.rooted.desc: You skip your Move step. Card effects still move you.
status.wrongTurn.desc: Your next Move step goes back {n|space|spaces} instead of rolling.
status.shielded.desc: Blocks the next reversed effect or trap. If it blocks nothing, it ends after your next turn and gives back 1 Fate Point.
status.trapImmune.desc: Traps do not affect you until your next turn.

game.rulesTitle: How to play and all the cards. The game waits while this is open.
rules.title: How to Play
rules.intro: A race round the zodiac for 2–4 players. Everything you need for your first game is on this page.
rules.quick.title: The game in 30 seconds
rules.quick.race.title: Race round the wheel
rules.quick.race.text: Everyone starts on Aries and runs clockwise round the 12 signs. Once someone completes {laps|lap|laps}, the round is played out and whoever has gone furthest wins.
rules.quick.turn.title: One action a turn
rules.quick.turn.text: Draw a card, then play a card, use your character or meditate. Then roll the Fate Die and move 1–3 spaces.
rules.quick.sides.title: Upright or reversed
rules.quick.sides.text: Upright effects boost you. Reversed effects trip the players ahead of you, so whoever falls behind can strike back.
rules.board.title: The board
rules.board.p1: The board is a ring of 12 zodiac signs. Clockwise is forward, starting from Aries. The four elements take turns, so each element comes back every 4 signs.
rules.board.p2: Your piece’s element sets your place in the turn order. After moving, end your turn on a sign of your element to gain {n|Fate Point|Fate Points} (Element Bonus).
rules.board.ahead: Players ahead of you: everyone who has gone further than you, laps included. A player you have lapped is behind you.
rules.board.leader: The leading player: whoever has gone furthest. Tied players all count as leading.
rules.setup.title: Setting up
rules.setup.character: Each player gets a random character (a Major Arcana card), upright or reversed at random, face up for everyone to see.
rules.setup.start: Everyone starts with {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} and {cards|card|cards} in hand.
rules.setup.laps: Choose 1, 2 or 3 laps. The standard game is 3.
rules.order.title: Turn order
rules.order.p1: Players act in element order: Fire, Earth, Air, Water. Empty seats are skipped.
rules.order.p2: The first player moves on one seat every round, so everyone takes turns acting last. In a 2-player game the same player sometimes acts twice in a row (last in one round, first in the next). That is normal.
rules.turn.title: Your turn
rules.turn.draw: Draw {n|card|cards} ({empty} if your hand is empty).
rules.turn.play: Choose one of four actions. You cannot pass.
rules.turn.play.a.title: Play a Minor card
rules.turn.play.a: Play one card, upright or reversed as you choose. If its element matches the sign you are on, gain {n|more Fate Point|more Fate Points} (Resonance).
rules.turn.play.b.title: Court combo
rules.turn.play.b: Play a court card with 2 Minor cards of the elements it asks for. Draw {n|card|cards} afterwards. No Resonance.
rules.turn.play.c.title: Character skill
rules.turn.play.c: Use the side of your character that is face up, for {n|Fate Point|Fate Points}. Not if you used it on your previous turn.
rules.turn.play.d.title: Meditate
rules.turn.flip: Pay {n|Fate Point|Fate Points} to turn your character over, at most once a turn. You can use the new side from your next turn.
rules.turn.move: Roll the Fate Die and move forward 1, 2 or 3 spaces. You may reroll once for {reroll|Fate Point|Fate Points} and boost +1 space once for {boost|Fate Point|Fate Points}; after a boost you cannot reroll. Passing or stopping on a trap springs it.
rules.turn.resolve: Element Bonus: if you moved this turn and stopped on a sign of your element, gain {eb|Fate Point|Fate Points}. Each new lap you reach gives {lap|Fate Point|Fate Points}, only once per lap even if you are pushed back and pass it again.
rules.turn.end: If you hold more than {n} cards, discard down to {n} (your choice). Statuses that have run their course end, and the next player goes.
rules.sides.title: Upright and reversed
rules.sides.intro: Every card has two sides, and choosing one is the key decision of each turn: boost yourself, or hold back the players in front?
rules.sides.up.title: Upright: boost yourself
rules.sides.up: Only helps you: move forward, Fate Points, cards, shields, better rolls.
rules.sides.down.title: Reversed: trip the players ahead
rules.sides.down: Only hits players ahead of you: they move back, move less, lose Fate Points, get negative statuses or run into traps.
rules.sides.r1: Minor and court cards played reversed hit every player ahead of you. There is no target to choose.
rules.sides.r2: A character’s reversed skill hits one player ahead of you, chosen by you. The Tower and the World hit every player ahead of you; the Devil and the Moon place a trap.
rules.sides.r3: If no one is ahead of you, you cannot use a reversed side: while you lead, you can only race.
rules.sides.r4: Most character reversed skills are stronger against the leading player. The card says “(the leader: …)”, usually {n} more. Not in 2-player games.
rules.sides.exampleHint: The upright effect is printed at the bottom. Turn the card round to read the reversed one.
rules.cards.title: The cards
rules.cards.deck: The fate deck has {deck} cards: {minor} Minor cards (10 of each suit) and {court} court cards (2 of each rank). The 22 Major Arcana are the characters and are not in the deck. When the deck runs out, the discard pile is shuffled into a new one.
rules.cards.minor.title: Minor Arcana
rules.cards.minor.intro: Each suit looks after one thing.
rules.cards.court.title: Court cards
rules.cards.court.intro: A court card cannot be played alone. Add 2 Minor cards, each of one of the two elements shown for the side you play (the same suit twice is fine). All three go to the discard pile; then draw {n|card|cards}.
rules.cards.major.title: Characters (Major Arcana)
rules.cards.major.p: Your character’s skill is action C: pay {skill|Fate Point|Fate Points} to use the side that is face up, but not two turns running. Turn it over in the Flip step for {flip|Fate Point|Fate Points}.
rules.cards.terms.title: Card wording
rules.cards.terms.next: “Move forward to the next Fire sign”: go to the nearest Fire sign ahead, not counting the one you are on (1–4 spaces). “Move back to the previous …” works the same way backwards.
rules.cards.terms.start: Nobody moves back past the start (Aries on the first lap).
rules.cards.terms.nextTurn: “Next turn”: the affected player’s next own turn, even if the effect came during their own turn.
rules.cards.terms.cap: Fate Points are capped at {cap}; anything above is lost. Losing or having them stolen stops at 0.
rules.fp.title: Fate Points
rules.fp.intro: Fate Points bend your luck. They do not win the game; they only break ties.
rules.fp.e.resonance: Resonance: play a Minor card on a sign of its element
rules.fp.e.element: Element Bonus: end your move on a sign of your element
rules.fp.e.shield: Shield refund: your shield runs out without blocking anything
rules.fp.cap: You can hold at most {cap|Fate Point|Fate Points}; anything above is lost. While Drained you cannot spend them.
rules.status.title: Statuses
rules.status.p1: A negative status affects the player’s next own turn and ends when that turn ends. “For the next N turns” lasts N turns.
rules.status.p2: The same status does not stack (the longer one stays); different statuses can be combined. “Remove all your negative statuses” keeps your shield.
rules.trap.title: Traps
rules.trap.p1: The Devil and the Moon place traps with their reversed side. A trap goes on a sign 1–{reach} spaces in front of a player ahead of you, so you cannot place one while you lead. One trap per sign, at most {max} on the board: a new one removes the oldest.
rules.trap.p2: A trap springs when another player passes or stops on its sign while moving themselves (their Move step, their own cards and skills), and is then removed. Being pushed by someone else or swapping places does not spring it, and its owner never does. Several traps on one move spring in order.
rules.trap.p3: When a trap springs, its owner gains {n|Fate Point|Fate Points}, even if a shield blocks it. Traps are stronger on the leading player (not in 2-player games).
rules.trap.chain: Rooted next turn and loses {fp|Fate Point|Fate Points} (the leader: {lead}); the move goes on.
rules.trap.illusion: Moves back {back|space|spaces} (the leader: {lead}); the move ends.
rules.win.title: Winning
rules.win.p1: When any player reaches the finish ({laps|lap|laps}), the final round begins: play goes on until the last player of this round has had their turn, even if the player at the finish is pushed back below it.
rules.win.p2: The player who has gone furthest wins; going past the finish counts. If tied, more Fate Points wins; if still tied, they share the win.
rules.screen.title: Playing on this site
rules.screen.cards: Click a card in your hand to open it. Point at a side to turn the card that way up, then play that side.
rules.screen.grey: Choices you cannot make right now are greyed out, with the reason under them.
rules.screen.hotseat: Several people on one device: hands are covered between turns. Pass the device; the next player confirms before their hand appears.
rules.screen.computer: Computer turns play back step by step. Change the speed (1×, 2×, 4×) or press Skip to jump to your next decision.
rules.screen.lang: Switch the language at any time, even in the middle of a game.
rules.screen.log: The log lists everything that happens. It never shows cards a player looks at or takes in secret.
rules.screen.rules: In a game, the Rules button opens this page and the cards. The game waits until you close it.
gallery.title: Cards
gallery.intro: All 30 cards: the 22 characters and the 8 kinds of card in the fate deck. Every card has an upright side (bottom) and a reversed side (top). Click a card to read both sides.
gallery.playersHint: Some cards read differently with 2 players: no leader bonus, and four skills change.
gallery.majorsNote: Not in the deck: each player gets one at random. Its skill is action C.
gallery.minorsNote: 10 of each suit in the deck. Played on their own (action A).
gallery.courtsNote: 2 of each rank in the deck. Played with 2 Minor cards of the elements shown (action B).
rules.cards.resonance: Resonance: play a Minor card on a sign of its own element to gain {n|more Fate Point|more Fate Points}.
small.title: Best on a bigger screen
small.text: Wheel of Fate is made for laptops and for tablets held sideways. Turn your tablet, or open the game on a computer.
sound.note: Music and effects are played in the browser as you go.
rules.screen.sound: Set the music and the sound effects with the speaker button at the top of the screen.
game.watchingHint: Every seat is a computer player: sit back and watch, or skip to the end.
banner.again: {player} goes again: first in the new round
banner.youAgain: You go again: you are first in the new round
